title: Rory and the Moon-Blossom Meadow
verses:
The evening drew close as the shadows grew long,
And Psittaco chirped from his nest in the trees.
He trilled a soft tune that was gentle and strong,
That drifted away on a cool summer breeze.

Sweet Nia flew down through the silver-blue air,
To guide them along to a hollow of moss.
She swooped to a clearing, serene and so fair,
Where light from the moon kissed the streamlet across.

Big Benny walked slow with his heavy, warm tread,
While Rory stepped soft on the cushiony ground.
Calm Tilly made space for a sleepy-time bed,
Where comforting quiet was tucked all around.

Blue blossoms uncurled in the shadowy glade,
And spilled a sweet scent through the calmness of night.
A bed of soft petals was gently arrayed,
To cradle the friends in a cozy blue light.

Sturdy Ricky sank down with his chin on his paw,
As Psittaco snuggled beneath Nia's wing.
They looked at the stars with a peaceful, sweet awe,
And listened to crickets that started to sing.

Friendly Rory gave thanks as he lowered his head,
While twilight wrapped over the dinos so deep.
With everyone warm in their velvety bed,
The whole quiet forest fell gently asleep.
